title: A warmer welcome, a lighter workspace
summary: Get to know Scribe with an optional workspace tour, enjoy smoother note browsing, and find a cleaner What’s New view with more reliable Quick Capture at startup.

items: A new interactive welcome tour introduces Scribe in 15 short steps. Create a note, try its right-click menu and learn how to move it to Trash, then explore the main settings. Keep the note or skip anytime, and replay the tour from About.
The tour adapts to offline profiles and online accounts, explains which optional features are off, and shows where to enable them. Offline users can keep using Scribe without signing in.
Scribe starts with less background work and loads Quick Capture’s window only when you first need it.
Browsing and editing notes is lighter, especially with long notes and larger collections. Card previews stay compact while the full note remains available when opened.
What’s New has a wider layout, clearer change cards and expandable descriptions. The title, version picker and Done button stay within reach as you scroll.
Quick Capture recovers from temporary shortcut setup delays when Scribe opens, reducing unexpected shortcut-not-ready messages.
Moving between notes and settings leaves less unnecessary work running in the background.
